title: Built a VR version of my sword-fighting parkour game!
author: deReaLizedGames
selftext:
Super excited about this development. I've shared this game on here before - it's a mix of Dark Messiah of Might and Magic/Dishonored/Dying Light with Mirror's Edge (my favorite games all mashed together lol). Everything was built with Claude, all assets were generated by Claude through Blender. 

The transition to VR was actually super easy, it got a solid first build in one prompt. This was because everything in the game is procedurally animated (which is what VR needs) and everything was already physics-based (the sword itself and enemies are both physics objects), so I didn't need to built anything new.

The hard part was actually optimization. The first build a month ago was getting \~20 fps. Opus 5 at the time really struggled to get any improvements and so I left it alone for a month. Yesterday I thought I'd give it another shot with Fable 5.2 and it was able to get it up to \~80 fps (though it took 12+ hours of back and forth trying different things lol). 

A couple features in the game I didn't get to show in this video: Physics-based Dark Messiah-style kick, wall-running, grabbing enemies, and an extended arm grapple + grab.

I'm really happy with how this came out, thanks for checking this out! Feel free to ask any questions in the comments and I'll try to respond to everyone tonight. I still don't have a name for this game, so if anyone's got ideas I'd love to hear them!

  
Also, a \*shameful\* plug for my first game on Steam, BoneHeads, lol:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5073210/BoneHeads/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5073210/BoneHeads/)
